title: Trap Within a Trap
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji finally locked onto the exact location where his sister Chen Nian was imprisoned, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shook violently—a blurry image flashed through his mind, showing Chen Nian bound by chains at the center of an altar, surrounded by ancient runes he had never seen before...

text.content:
Dawn's first light appeared, and a thin mist drifted through the Bamboo Grove at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji brought the secret letter close to his eyes, carefully examining the patterns on the wax seal under the rising sun.

It was the private seal of the current Prime Minister's mansion—a soaring Xuanwu bird, its claws resting on the Big Dipper. He had seen this pattern in the capital, when he was still the spirited young man of the Chen family, having accompanied his father to a grand autumn hunt in the palace.

The ink on the letter had dried, but the chilling aura emanating from between the lines made Chen Ji's lips curve upward slightly. "Interesting," he murmured, "a marriage cancellation，居然惊动了丞相府的大人物。"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji tucked the secret letter into his sleeve, his gaze falling on the already cold corpse not far away. That was the mastermind behind the marriage cancellation incident, who had been shrieking before death about making Chen Ji suffer worse than death, yet now couldn't even leave a complete corpse.

"Your script was well-designed," Chen Ji crouched down, fishing out a token from the dead man's waist, which bore the emblem of Xuanwu Sect, "Unfortunately, you were just a puppet on stage."

text.content:
Sudden hurried footsteps echoed from outside the bamboo grove. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he quickly hid the token. A familiar figure stumbled in—it was Han Lie, the number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect, yet now looking as wretched as a stray dog.

His robes were torn, a deep gash visible on his chest reaching to the bone, blood staining half his body. Upon seeing Chen Ji, Han Lie's eyes flashed with shock, then transformed into savage killing intent.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Han Lie ground his teeth, his voice trembling from blood loss, "It was you... it was your trap! Those people who attacked us... you led them here!"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, a gentle smile spreading across his face—so pure and harmless in the morning light. "What makes Han Senior Brother say such things?" He blinked, wearing an expression of complete innocence, "I was merely passing through this place. Seeing Han Senior Brother in this state... my heart truly aches."

dialogue.content:
Han Lie trembled with rage, then suddenly broke into violent coughing, blood bubbling from the corners of his mouth. His legs went weak, and he fell to one knee, barely supporting himself with his sword.

"What... what do you want?" His voice had already taken on a note of despair.

text.content: Chen Ji crouched down to meet Han Lie's eyes at the same level. His gaze was calm to the point of being terrifying, like looking at a beast trapped in a snare. "Han Senior Brother," he said softly, "Have you ever wondered why the attackers happened to appear exactly when you were at your weakest?"

dialogue.content: "Because of that secret letter." Chen Ji produced the letter he had read countless times from his sleeve, waving it before Han Lie's eyes. "Your 'good ally' sold you out. He traded your whereabouts for the Prime Minister's support, and conveniently dragged me into it. Killing three birds with one stone—what an exquisite chess game."

text.content:
Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, an incredulous expression flashing across his face. "Impossible... we had an agreement..." His voice cut off abruptly as he realized he had said too much.

Chen Ji nodded with satisfaction, like a teacher praising a student who finally answered correctly. "See? This is what happens when cleverness backfires."

dialogue.content: "You knew from the very beginning!" Han Lie's head snapped up, his eyes filled with shock and fury. "Those rumors about your strength... they were all lies! You've been hiding your true abilities all along!"

text.content:
Chen Ji offered no answer, merely rising to his feet and brushing nonexistent dust from his robes. He turned to gaze into the depths of the bamboo grove, as if waiting for something.

A moment later, orderly footsteps sounded from all directions. Dozens of disciples from Tianqing Sect's Law Enforcement Hall emerged from the mist, led by Elder Zhao, who had always been at odds with Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "Elder Zhao, you've arrived at the perfect time." Chen Ji turned around, his face showing perfectly calibrated panic and grievance. "This disciple was meditating at the Back Mountain when this Han Senior Brother from Xuanwu Sect appeared... he, he tried to silence me by murder!"

text.content:
Han Lie's eyes widened, nearly spitting blood from rage. He pointed at Chen Ji and roared: "You're slandering me! Clearly you set the trap—"

"Han Senior Brother," Chen Ji cut him off, his voice gentle enough to soothe a child, "You're wearing Xuanwu Sect robes, while I'm in Tianqing Sect servant robes. Who do you think the elders will believe?"

dialogue.content: Elder Zhao swept his gaze across the scene, lingering briefly on the corpse and Han Lie. He said nothing, but the corners of his mouth lifted slightly. "Chen Ji, you've done well." He waved his hand. "Take Han Young Master to receive treatment. When he's recovered, we'll have a proper chat about today's events."

text.content:
As Han Lie was being dragged away, he struggled with all his might, but with such severe injuries he couldn't resist at all. His final glance at Chen Ji was filled with deep-seated hatred, as if trying to etch this calm face into his bones.

Chen Ji watched him go, the gentle smile on his face gradually fading, replaced by a deeper contemplation.

choice.prompt: After Elder Zhao departed, Chen Ji stood alone in the bamboo grove. Han Lie's appearance made him realize the plan was going even smoother than anticipated—the cooperation between Xuanwu Sect and the Prime Minister's mansion had already shown cracks. But more information on that secret letter still awaited interpretation...

choices.text: Continue investigating the clues in the letter
choices.description: There were more details on that letter worth digging into, especially regarding his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time, possibly miss the best opportunity
choices.risk_hint: The night is long, the enemy may have grown suspicious

text.content:
Chen Ji spread open the secret letter once more, this time probing the depths of the paper with his divine sense. The letter used an extremely hidden cipher—ordinary people would see only insignificant pleasantries, but in his eyes, those words formed a secret map.

The map's destination was赫然标注着圣宗禁地的方位. Beside it was a line of small text: "The key is in position, awaiting orders."

dialogue.content:
The key... Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. That term he had seen in the Tianji Record Fragment, referring to a special fate—one that could serve as a vessel to bear the backlash of destiny.

His heart clenched tightly. Chen Nian... sister, she...

choices.text: Immediately arrange the subsequent chess game
choices.description: Han Lie has entered the game, the next step should be to make the Prime Minister's Manor and Xuanwu Sect completely break apart.
choices.visible_cost: The intelligence may not be complete enough
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient information may lead to variables

text.content:
Chen Ji took out a Jade Slip from his bosom, his divine sense sinking into it. The Jade Slip recorded all the evidence of secret correspondence between Han Lie and the Prime Minister's Manor—these, he had collected little by little over three months.

"It's time for these things to play their role." The corner of his mouth slightly lifted, his fingers lightly flicked the Jade Slip, a wisp of information quietly transmitted. Target: Xuanwu Sect Master.

choices.text: Return to the Tianji Record to seek answers
choices.description: The "lock key" mentioned in the letter matches the records in the Tianji Record, perhaps more information can be obtained from the fragment.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is limited, it cannot be abused

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji found a secluded mountain cave, sitting cross-legged. The Tianji Record Fragment emerged from his chest, its ancient paper radiating a cold, eerie glow. Mo Xiansheng's figure condensed from the text, his expression grave.

"You saw it." Mo Xiansheng sighed, "The matter of the lock key, this old man wanted to wait until your foundation was stable before telling you."

text.content:
"Chen Nian... she is my sister." Chen Ji's voice was calm, but his clenched fists revealed the turmoil in his heart, "How is she now?"

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before saying: "She is enduring the backlash of fate for someone. That person... is related to the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

Three days later, news spread that Tianqing Sect Outer Disciple Chen Ji had "accidentally" rescued an injured Xuanwu Sect disciple. Some said he was foolish, saving someone despite his old grudge with Han Lie; others said he was stupid, daring to provoke the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius.

Only Chen Ji himself knew that everything was part of the plan.

Late at night, Chen Ji came to that secluded mountain cave again. The Tianji Record Fragment hovered before him, Mo Xiansheng's figure faintly visible.

"Are you sure you want to do this?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of worry, "To foresee three hours ahead, each use costs five Heavenly Fate Value. Your current Heavenly Fate Value... is less than a hundred days' worth."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not answer, only closing his eyes. A faint golden light appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment, as the power of foresight slowly flowed.

A moment later, he opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting fragments of the future—Chen Nian bound by chains on an altar, surrounded by flickering runes. Beside the altar stood a blurry figure, its face unreadable, but that oppressive aura made Chen Ji's heart tighten.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng sighed. "Did you see it?"

"The altar is deep within the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable determination, "She is enduring the backlash of fate for someone... who is that person?"

"This old man cannot say." Mo Xiansheng shook his head, "But this old man can tell you, she still has three months. Beyond this deadline..." He did not finish, but the meaning was clear.

Three months.

Chen Ji gripped his fists tightly, his fingernails almost piercing his palms. He had too many enemies to avenge, too many schemes to orchestrate, too many adversaries to eliminate—but now, everything had to make way for his sister.

"I understand." He stood up, "Within three months, I will personally go to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng watched his retreating figure, a complex expression flickering in his eyes. "Are you sure three months will be enough?"

"It has to be enough." Chen Ji did not look back, his voice unexpectedly calm, "She is my only remaining family in this world."

text.content:
Walking out of the cave, the night wind brushed against his face. Chen Ji looked up at the horizon, where countless stars dotted the sky, like countless indifferent eyes watching him.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao... you think by using my sister as a chess piece, you can control everything?

A cold smile curved his lips, that grin looking especially icy in the night.

choice.prompt: The three-month time window has been confirmed, but there are too many things to handle: Han Lie's hatred, the Xuanwu Sect's conspiracy, the Prime Minister's layout, and... that old Sect Master Ling Yuan who has always been observing from the shadows. Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Time is tight, must immediately begin preparing the plan to rescue Chen Nian. Other matters can be set aside.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity to suppress enemies
choices.risk_hint: Hasty action may lead to plan vulnerabilities

text.content:
Chen Ji returned to his quarters that night and took out the map he had long prepared. Three routes leading to the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds were marked on it, each one repeatedly deduced by him.

"The Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds..." he murmured, "Ye Qing should know the detailed layout there."

dialogue.content:
A black transmission talisman was silently activated, and Chen Ji left a brief message on it: Three days later, the old place.

The Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing would receive this message immediately. She owed him a favor—the truth about her being used by the Holy Sect, which he had shown her through the Tianji Record. That foresight changed everything.

choices.description: The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the power. To save his sister, he must first become stronger.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal rescue timing

text.content:
Chen Ji reopened the Tianji Record, his gaze falling on the puzzle left by Mo Xiansheng. The condition to unseal the second page was: make the sworn enemy verbally admit defeat.

Han Lie had already been brought to disgrace through his schemes, but the final blow was still needed—getting him to utter the words "I lose."

dialogue.content:
"Interesting." A subtle curve formed at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, "Since Han Lie is so eager to prove himself, let's give him an opportunity."

He picked up his pen and wrote a name and address on paper. This was a "clue" for Su Qingyao—evidence of Han Lie's secret meetings with the Prime Minister's residence.

choices.description: Suppress enemies and accumulate resources on the surface while secretly preparing the rescue plan. Maximum risk, but also maximum gain.
choices.risk_hint: Problems may arise on both fronts

text.content:
Chen Ji decided to pursue both lines simultaneously. In his mind, he rapidly deduced every detail of the plan:

On the surface, he would continue playing the role of that cowardly, incompetent waste of a servant disciple, letting everyone lower their guard. Secretly, he needed to control multiple chess games simultaneously—the downfall of Han Lie, the chaos in the Prime Minister's residence, and... the intelligence gathering about the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds.

dialogue.content:
"Ye Qing needs to be contacted as soon as possible," he muttered to himself, "Su Qingyao's investigation must also continue. And Ling Yuan... that old fox has been too quiet lately. That's never a good sign."

He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest grew slightly warm. In this moment, he felt like he was walking a tightrope—one misstep and everything would fall apart.

text.content:
In the days that followed, Chen Ji began his疯狂的双面生活.

During the day, he was that most inconspicuous servant disciple at the Tianqing Sect, sweeping floors, carrying water, being ordered around by fellow disciples. When someone deliberately caused trouble, he would put on that signature timid smile, bowing and scraping in apology.

At night, he was the chess master controlling the overall situation. Through transmission talismans and meticulously crafted "intelligence," he manipulated Han Lie, the Prime Minister's residence, and even the Xuanwu Sect Master like pieces on a chessboard.

The news of Han Lie's "secret communication with external enemies" finally reached the Xuanwu Sect Master's ears. That old man who had been proud his whole life flew into a rage and immediately ordered a full investigation. The entire Xuanwu Sect was plunged into a silent storm.

dialogue.content:
On the fifth night, Chen Ji met Ye Qing at a secluded pavilion in the Rear Mountain.

The Demonic Path Saint still wore that languid appearance, her moon-white long dress gently swaying in the night breeze. But when she spoke, her voice carried a凝重 gravitas: "You're going to the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds?"

Chen Ji nodded: "My sister is there."

text.content:
Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, a complex expression flickering in her eyes. "Do you know what's there?"

"The Fate Altar." Chen Ji looked straight into her eyes, "My sister is bearing fate's backlash for someone. That person... is related to the Heavenly Eye."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's body visibly stiffened. She turned around, her back to Chen Ji, her voice carrying an imperceptible tremor. "Do you know why I've survived until now?"

Chen Ji did not answer.

"Because the Holy Sect needs me." Ye Qing's voice was very soft, "I was once... a Lock Key."

text.content:
These words struck Chen Ji's mind like thunder. His pupils constricted as he stared at Ye Qing's back.

"And then?" he asked.

"Then I met you." Ye Qing turned around, a self-deprecating smile curving her lips, "You showed me a prophecy through the Tianji Record—if I didn't resist, I would die on the altar in three months. You changed my fate."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent. He remembered that foresight—he had originally wanted to use the Tianji Record to obtain intelligence, but accidentally glimpsed Ye Qing's future. That was an extremely blurry vision because her fate was also intertwined with Chen Nian's.

"So this time, it's my turn to help you." Ye Qing took a deep breath, her eyes rekindling with determination, "I can draw the layout of the forbidden grounds for you, but there's one thing you must know—"

text.content:
She leaned close to Chen Ji, her voice so low that only the two of them could hear: "The person on the altar... is none of the Holy Sect's high-ranking members. He is the projection of the Heavenly Eye in the mortal world. Your sister is bearing karmic backlash for it."

Chen Ji's heart plummeted.

choice.prompt: After learning the truth, Chen Ji fell into a brief silence. His sister's fate was directly linked to the Eye of Heavenly Way—this meant his enemies were far more terrifying than he had imagined. But retreat at this point was already too late.

choices.text: No matter who the enemy is, he must save her.
choices.description: So what if it's the Eye of Heavenly Way? Anything standing between him and his sister must be crushed.
choices.risk_hint: May触怒 the vigilance of the Eye of Heavenly Way.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve: "The Eye of Heavenly Way... sooner or later, I will pull it down from its divine throne. But right now, I only want to save my sister." He raised his head, his gaze like a blade: "Will you help me?"

Ye Qing gazed into his eyes, long silent. In that instant, she saw a terrifying light within this seemingly cowardly youth—a madness that placed no heed even on Heavenly Way. "Alright." She nodded, "I'll help you."

choices.text: First, understand why Chen Nian became the Lock Key.
choices.description: Blind action is too dangerous. Must first understand the connection between his sister and the Eye of Heavenly Way.
choices.risk_hint: Investigation may触怒 the Eye of Heavenly Way.

text.content: "Why would my sister become the Lock Key?" Chen Ji asked in a heavy voice, "Could the Chen family have some connection to the Eye of Heavenly Way?" Ye Qing shook her head: "I'm not sure about that. But I know becoming a Lock Key requires two conditions—a special destiny, and... being chosen."

dialogue.content: She took out a jade slip from her sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji: "This is the information I've collected about Lock Keys. Perhaps it can help you." Chen Ji took the jade slip and probed it with his spiritual sense. Moments later, his expression became extremely grim—the materials mentioned that a Lock Key's destiny must be inherited through bloodline. "The Chen family..." His pupils contracted sharply, "Could it be that our Chen family for generations has been..."

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to foresee again.
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee Chen Nian's specific situation and potential variables.

text.content: Chen Ji decided to take a risk. He took out the Tianji Record Fragment and pressed his palm against its surface. Golden light flickered again as the foresight power began to flow. This time, the images he saw were even clearer—Chen Nian was trapped in the center of an altar, surrounded by black chains. Those chains were not ordinary material, but condensed from pure karma force.

dialogue.content: What alarmed him even more was a vague figure standing beside the altar. That figure emanated a pressure beyond mortal comprehension, as if Heavenly Way itself was watching everything. "The projection of the Eye of Heavenly Way..." Chen Ji murmured, cold sweat dripping from his forehead. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, seemingly warning him not to continue looking.

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly withdrew his spiritual sense, his body swaying, nearly falling. The golden light on the Tianji Record Fragment dimmed, his face as pale as paper. "I saw it." He gasped, "The entrance to the altar lies at the deepest part of the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds. To open it requires解开 three seals simultaneously... and each seal corresponds to a different key."

Night deepened, Chen Ji stood alone before the window, gazing at the waning moon on the horizon. In his hand he held the jade slip from Ye Qing, along with the foresight images just revealed by the Tianji Record. Three months. Three seals. Three keys. He needed to collect three keys within three months,解开 three seals, break into the deepest part of the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, defeat the projection of the Eye of Heavenly Way—and then rescue his sister from the altar.

It sounded like an impossible mission. But Chen Ji smiled. That smile was faint, yet revealed a chilling intent—this was the smile of the废物 Chen, the one he wore only when calculating everything. "Three months, huh..." he said softly, "That's enough."

He turned and walked toward the writing desk, spreading a blank sheet of rice paper. The brush tip, saturated with ink, touched down on the paper with its first stroke—a name: Han Lie.

The first key lies within you.

The smile at the corner of his lips grew increasingly profound as Chen Ji lifted his brush to write the second line: Xuanwu Sect, Tianhuo Secret Realm.

The chess game that belonged to him had officially begun.

At the same moment, in a secret chamber deep within the Tianqing Sect.

Ling Yuan sat upright on a meditation cushion, eyes tightly closed. Before him floated an ancient bronze mirror, its surface reflecting Chen Ji's figure—that youth hunched over the candlelight, writing furiously.

"Interesting..." Ling Yuan opened his eyes, a meaningfully knowing smile curling at the corner of his lips, "So this is your true intention."

He rose and pushed open the secret chamber door. Outside, a figure in black waited respectfully.

dialogue.content:
"Investigate that woman named Chen Nian thoroughly." Ling Yuan's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable authority. "Leave no stone unturned in uncovering her secrets."

The black-clad figure departed with his orders, vanishing into the night.

Ling Yuan lifted his gaze toward the horizon, where a crescent moon hung like a hook, its pale light falling across his weathered face. "Chen Ji, Chen Ji... do you truly believe yourself the Chess Player?" he murmured with a knowing chuckle. "To me, you're merely a more valuable piece on the board."

text.content:
Far away, thousands of miles distant, deep within the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds.

A massive altar stood at the heart of an underground palace, its surface alive with flowing runes that emanated an eerie radiance. Chen Nian was bound by black chains at the altar's center, eyes shut tight, her complexion ashen as paper.

The surrounding air thrummed with a suffocating weight—the oppressive presence of the Heavenly Dao's Eye projection.

Chen Nian's eyelids trembled faintly, as if sensing something. Her lips parted, producing a barely audible whisper:

"Brother... Brother..."

The void beside the altar rippled subtly, and that hazy silhouette appeared to grow more substantial. An invisible pressure descended upon Chen Nian, drawing a pained furrow to her brow.

Yet despite this, the corners of her mouth slightly curved upward—for she understood with certainty that her brother would come to rescue her. Absolutely.
